commands.command:
date -u
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
echo SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION_LITERAL_SCAN
n=0
for f in /usr/bin/* /usr/sbin/*; do
 if test -f "$f"; then
  n=$((n+1))
  grep -a -l -F -e normal_off_sensing_required -e force_off_sensing_required -e reinforce_off_sensing "$f"
 fi
done
echo "SCANNED_DIRECT_SYSTEM_FILES=$n"
date -u
